items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: The transcript only identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. There is no mention of any prior personal or professional relationship between Sam Most and Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: Sam was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 15, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Los Angeles filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’ve been looking forward to talking with Sam Most, saxophonist, flautist and clarinetist. You’ve been around for a long time, like on the forefront of a number of things in jazz. So welcome.
